name: ledger
description: Record and query personal income and expenses. Amounts are number strings like "35.50". A foreign currency is converted into the book's currency and the rate is frozen on the entry. add returns a budget field when a monthly budget is near or past its limit. Books, accounts, categories and budgets belong to manage_ledger.

kind.description: add/list, default expense. A transfer moves money between two accounts.

currency.description: add: ISO code, default the book's.

category.description: An unknown name is created on add/update and the result says so; list never creates one.

account.description: add/list: where the money came from, the source for a transfer. Every book starts with 现金, 电子支付, 交通卡, 信用卡 and 银行卡.

note.description: add/update: what it was for, including the shop.

period.description: list/summary: a month like 2026-09 or a range like 2026-09-01..2026-09-15, default this month. summary takes a month only.

book.description: Only needed when more than one exists.

id.description: update/delete: the entry id or a unique prefix of it.

force.description: add: record even when an identical entry exists from minutes ago.
